scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
This is our advance base
to stop Morocc.
I'm a tracker
charged with leading my army
to Morocc's lair.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
这里是阻止梦罗克的前进基地。
我是追踪者，负责引导军队前往他的巢穴。

scripts.text:
Your backpack is too full
I can't talk to you!
scripts.translation: 你的背包太满了，没法继续交谈！

scripts.text:
You need to reach level 160 first
to enter the Red Flower!
scripts.translation: 进入红色花朵需要先达到160级！

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
We're nowhere near close
to stopping Morocc's resurrection.
I can't sleep at night,
knowing Morocc is doing everything he can
to recover his strength.
Could you come back tomorrow?
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
距离阻止梦罗克复活，我们还差得远。
一想到他正竭尽全力恢复力量，我就夜不能寐。
明天能再来吗？

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
I knew you'd return.
You look well-rested.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
我就知道你会回来的。
你看起来休息得很好。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
According to my intel,
Morocc is hiding out in this place,
recovering his strength.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
据情报，梦罗克就藏在这里，正在恢复力量。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
Fighting Morocc
takes more than a few warriors, no matter how strong they are.
I recommend you join forces with
as many comrades as you can find.
Are you ready to enter the Red Flower
where Morocc is believed to be hiding?
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
要对抗梦罗克，光靠几个战士可不行，实力再强也不够。
建议你尽可能多找些同伴。
准备好进入梦罗克可能藏身的红色花朵了吗？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
Come back
if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
改变主意的话再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
The entrance to the Red Flower
is not open yet.
Please come back later
and try again.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
红色花朵的入口还没打开，请稍后再来。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
The entrance to the Red Flower
has opened.
It will only stay open for a while.
You'd better use it
while you can.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
红色花朵的入口已经打开，但只能维持一段时间。
赶快趁现在进去吧。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
This is our advance base
to stop Morocc.
I'm a tracker
charged with leading my army
to Morocc's lair.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
这里是阻止梦罗克的前进基地。
我是追踪者，负责引导军队前往他的巢穴。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
After a painstaking search,
I've located
the place with the highest chance of
hiding Morocc inside.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
费了好大一番工夫，终于找到了梦罗克最有可能藏身的地方。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
According to my intel,
Morocc is hiding out in this place,
trying to recover
his full strength.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
据情报，梦罗克就藏在这里，试图恢复全部力量。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
Even though I've located this place myself,
I have to admit
that I'm not equipped to
explore it by myself.
I'm a tracker after all, not a fighter.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
地方虽然是我找到的，可我也得承认，自己还没本事独自进去探索。
毕竟我是追踪者，不擅长战斗。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
You look like
a warrior spoiling for
a good fight with Morocc,
and I think
you have a chance at winning it.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
看你的样子，应该正渴望与梦罗克大战一场吧？
我觉得你有机会赢。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
How'd you like to
enter Morocc's lair,
defeat him,
and become the hero
who saved the world from evil?
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
要不要闯进梦罗克的巢穴，打败他，成为将世界从邪恶中拯救出来的英雄？

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
If you're interested in my proposition,
let me talk to your party leader.
We'll discuss more details together.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
对这个提议感兴趣的话，请你们队长来，我们再详细商量。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
Morocc may not have recovered his full strength, but fighting him still
takes more than a few warriors, no matter how strong they are.
I recommend you join forces with
as many comrades as you can find.
Are you ready to enter the Red Flower
where Morocc is believed to be hiding?
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
梦罗克也许还没恢复全部力量，可要对抗他，光靠几个战士仍然不够，实力再强也不行。
建议你尽可能多找些同伴。
准备好进入梦罗克可能藏身的红色花朵了吗？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
Come back
if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
改变主意的话再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
The entrance to the Red Flower
is not open yet.
Please come back later
and try again.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
红色花朵的入口还没打开，请稍后再来。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
The entrance to the Red Flower
has opened.
It will only stay open for a while.
You'd better use it
while you can.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
红色花朵的入口已经打开，但只能维持一段时间。
赶快趁现在进去吧。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
Finally you're back!
What happened in there?
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
你终于回来了！
里面发生了什么？

scripts.text:
- You relay
your experience in the Red Flower. -
scripts.translation: - 你讲述在红色花朵中的经历。-

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
So Morocc got away.
That's a shame.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
所以梦罗克逃走了。
真遗憾。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
At least
you wiped out
his army.
That's an accomplishment in itself.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
至少你消灭了他的军队，这本身就是一份战功。

scripts.text:
[Senior Tracker]
At least we know
where he is.
Could you come back tomorrow
and help me track
him down again?
I'll be waiting here.
scripts.translation:
[资深追踪者]
至少我们知道他在哪里。
明天能再来帮我追踪他吗？我会在这里等你。
